benchmarks.description: List of benchmarks to run. Each item defines a scene and optional overrides for scene options. The scene name must match one listed via --list-scenes. Options must be valid for that scene (see manpage BENCHMARKS section). The first benchmark may be omitted to allow default options to apply globally to subsequent benchmarks. Use empty string for scene to set defaults only (equivalent to :opt=val:...).

default_options.description: List of colon-separated key=value options (e.g. ['duration=5.0']) to apply as defaults to all benchmarks. Set via :key=value before any scene in the benchmark list. These are NOT passed directly to CLI, but rendered as :key=value lines in the config. Must match allowed options for each scene (see --list-scenes output).
